title: مديرية أمن طرابلس: الاتفاق على تأسيس منظومة البلاغات الموحدة بمراكز الشرطة
why_not: An agreement of 23 January 2023 between the Tripoli directorate and the Ministry's Information and Documentation Centre to begin building a unified complaints system for police stations: an intention, with no plan document, finance or manner of entry stated. It bears on the first-complaint record (O), which is not a gap aspect.
